angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 535,689 km at 59.44 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.8245 +/- 0.0128 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 59.44 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.77 +/- 0.009 solar radii from Psaridi et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-815 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract): 535,689 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.776 +/- 0.036 solar masses from Psaridi et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-815 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4869 +/- 77 K from Psaridi et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-815 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Psaridi et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-815 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-815.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.555, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): spectral type K3 V, from Psaridi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-43 6219: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.09 dex, from Psaridi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.50459, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): age 0.2 Gyr, from Psaridi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): rotation period 15.3 d, from Psaridi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-815 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1 km/s, from Psaridi et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A...5P/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.77 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.393. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
